scope: Review null race_restriction records where available references explicitly show the skill is not a CaC race restriction, or where the named skill is a cast-character skill later obtainable universally.

sources.finding: Power Pole is a Strike Super used by Goku (GT), obtainable from the Skill Shop; no CaC race lock is stated.
Xenoverse 2 reference says Power Pole and Power Pole Combo can be obtained by the Future Warrior; Earthling restriction is attached to Power Pole Pro instead.
Spirit Stab is a Vegito skill obtainable from the TP Medal Shop; no race restriction is stated.
Saiyan Blaster is identified as Broly (DB Super)'s Evasive Skill; the exact reference does not state a Saiyan CaC restriction.

boundary: A character's name or association is not treated as a CaC race restriction. Null is preserved when the reference does not explicitly establish a restriction.
next: Continue remaining null records with exact-skill evidence, prioritizing explicit CaC restriction wording and avoiding inference from skill names or notable users.
